method.check1_words: Local whisper.cpp ggml-small, Devanagari pass (-l hi) plus a Latin pass (-l en, which translates but exposes the English nouns). No script prompt. The connector's Scribe transcribed every take, but its text cannot be read back with the available tools.
method.check2_tags: No tag word appears in any transcript.
method.check3_length: Speech span (first to last speech, ffmpeg silencedetect at -40 dB, 50 ms) against target_seconds, within 20%. Raw file length is also given; targets include the speaker-change gap (script timing_note).
method.check4_quiet: Per-segment RMS split at the >=300 ms pause, compared with the same voice's plain lines (v4 l02 -21.3 dB, l05 -23.9 dB). There are no v3 plain Meenu lines, and v3 renders about 4-8 dB hotter than v4 on the same text, so cross-model level is confounded. Added a voiced-frame ratio (autocorrelation, 60-400 Hz) to tell a whisper from a quiet voiced line.
